description: Contract version manifest and the frozen payload of the `status --json` contracts discovery field. One call tells a consumer which contract versions this CLI implements.

discovery.note: mcpProtocol is the negotiated/default legacy protocol; allowed values are listed in mcp/versions-v1.json supportedProtocolVersions. exitCodes stays 1 until exit-codes-v2.draft.json is activated with the policy engine.

cliJson.consumer: scripts / third parties / DSH / MCP read models

mcpTools.consumer: MCP clients (Claude Code / Cursor / Copilot Studio)

mcpModern.note: 0.4.0 dual-era MCP: the legacy negotiation matrix in mcp/versions-v1.json is unchanged, and this artifact adds the stateless modern 2026-07-28 era (server/discover, per-request _meta, resultType/ttlMs/cacheScope envelopes, modern error mapping). Additive, not in discovery.expected: status.contracts keeps mcpProtocol 2024-11-05 so 0.3.2 status consumers stay byte-compatible; modern clients discover the era through the MCP server/discover method instead. Conformance: responses-v2.schema.json covers the modern envelope only and the payload is validated against the frozen responses-v1.schema.json $defs.

dshTools.note: 6 tools (0.3.2 M3): today/who/evidence read the real ledger read-only through advisers/lib/ledger-read.js; brief/office are local; advisers_clients adds the read-only customer list/show projection. Error codes preserved in errors/codes.v1.json external section; the DSH output schemas stay additive.

petBrief.note: closed schema owned by docs/pet-brief; not duplicated here (copying a closed contract invites drift).
petBrief.consumer: Famling / desktop-games (cross-repo, not in this CI)
